components.name: AppShell
components.summary: 2-panel floating Bento shell of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4): - Outer bg-canvas (#111111) with md:p-2 md:gap-2 - Collapsible rounded-2xl bg-panel left menu (w-52 <-> w-14 icon rail, persisted in localStorage) - Rounded-2xl bg-app right content panel with max-w-[1440px] container - Mobile (< md): hides the top logo header and renders MobileTabBar at the bottom (plus a bottom sheet if >5 routes)

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Standard Bento Tag/Badge primitive with dual-theme tonal matching. Uses 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for dark and light modes. /

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate activity mark for a button or field running its own action (§13b: no page spinners). */

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button and Spinner: the component form of BTN_* / MODAL_BTN_* (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §9).

components.name: Card
components.summary: Bento content card (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §5): CARD / CARD_HOVER / CARD_ACTIVE as a component.

components.name: ChatAvatar
components.summary: Small sparkles tile in front of every AI answer (pulses while it streams). */

components.name: ChatThinking
components.summary: "Đang suy nghĩ" (or what the AI is doing) with three bouncing dots, while no text has come yet. */

components.name: UserMessage
components.summary: The user's message, right-aligned. `failed`: its answer failed (shown dimmed, not sent again). */

components.name: AssistantMessage
components.summary: An AI answer, left-aligned behind the avatar. `actions` (copy, feedback) show under it once it is done. */

components.name: ChatError
components.summary: A failed answer (or an AI note in a warning tone), with an optional retry. */

components.name: ChatCopyButton
components.summary: Copies `text` (an answer, a code block); shows a check for a moment. */

components.name: ChatIntro
components.summary: Icon, title and one line above an empty conversation. */

components.name: ChatSuggestion
components.summary: One suggested request (a button), or with `href` a link to another site (opens outside the app). */

components.name: ChatSuggestions
components.summary: A column of ChatSuggestion rows, with an optional small heading. */

components.name: ChatList
components.summary: The scrolling message list (role="log"). Follows new text only while the reader is at the bottom: scrolled up to read, it stays put and offers "jump to latest". Streamed tokens are not read out one by one; when `busy` ends the finished answer (`announcement`, else "answer complete") is announced once. `empty` (only the intro / suggestions showing) keeps it at the top so the intro is read from its start. /

components.name: ChatComposer
components.summary: The question field with send / stop, and an optional `toolbar` under it (model picker, attachments). Controlled: the caller keeps the text (so it can fill it, e.g. from a suggestion). Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, and Enter while an input method is composing (Vietnamese Telex / VNI, CJK) only confirms the word. Focus returns to the field once the answer to a typed question is done (not after one the app started itself: that would pop up the keyboard on a tablet). /

components.name: ChatView
components.summary: Loading skeleton, `setup` (e.g. "AI is not set up" + a settings button) in place of the chat, or the list above the composer. */

components.name: ChatPanel
components.summary: The side panel an AI conversation opens in. `placement="workspace"`: inside the nearest positioned parent, beside the content (a tool's canvas, the page). `"screen"`: over the whole page as a dialog, also above an open Modal. Phones always get the full screen. Resizable from `sm` (remembered per `widthKey`); Escape and × close it. Keep it mounted with `shown={false}` while it slides out, then unmount. /

components.name: ChatAnswer
components.summary: An answer as most chats show it: the error (with retry), the Markdown text with copy, or "thinking" while empty. */

components.name: AIChat
components.summary: ChatPanel + ChatView + ChatComposer with the messages drawn the standard way. The app owns `messages` and `busy`; the composer text is kept here unless `value` / `onValueChange` are passed (to fill it from a suggestion). /

components.name: Chip
components.summary: On/off toggle chip (multi-select filters, outcome pickers) + the shared chip colours.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: CustomCombobox
components.summary: Free-text input with suggestions (WAI-ARIA combobox): type to filter, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to pick, Escape to close.

components.name: CustomSelect
components.summary: App-styled dropdown (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: never a native <select>, its OS popup ignores the theme).

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Date field with an app-styled calendar popover (the browser's own date popup is white and ignores the theme).

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side sheet for secondary tasks that keep the page in view (filters, record details, settings).

components.name: ExternalLink
components.summary: Links to other sites (docs, shops): always a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14).

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Callout inside a page or form (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3b): tinted surface, tone icon, optional action / dismiss. */

components.name: Progress

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Person or team mark: photo, else initials on a tone picked from the name (stable per name). */

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Empty list / first-run state: icon, one short line, optional description and action (EMPTY surface). */

components.name: Field
components.summary: Form field: label + control + hint / error, wired for assistive tech (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md "Form fields").

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text input on the field surface (FIELD_INPUT). For numbers use NumberInput, for dates DatePicker. */

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text on the field surface (FIELD_TEXTAREA). */

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Shared inline stroke icons + tinted icon tiles (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14–15).

components.name: IconTile
components.summary: Rounded square with an icon: the leading visual of cards, list rows and dialogs. */

components.name: KpiCard
components.summary: KPI metric card of the Semi Design System (ported from 3D Noobs Studio jobs/ui.tsx).

components.name: Markdown
components.summary: Light markdown for AI answers: paragraphs, headings (as bold lines), lists, **bold**, `code`, links.

components.name: MobileTabBar
components.summary: Phones (< md): native-style bottom tab bar with up to 6 primary navigation items.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Shared modal dialog of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14).

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Drop-in <input> for numbers: on touch screens (phone / iPad: `pointer: coarse`) it opens the app's NumPadPopup instead of the system keyboard; elsewhere it is a plain input.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Short hint for an icon-only control (one line, no interactive content). The trigger keeps its own aria-label; the tooltip is linked with aria-describedby. Touch screens show nothing: never put essential text in a tooltip. /

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Action menu behind a trigger button (row / card overflow actions). ↑/↓ move, Enter / Space pick, Escape closes and returns focus. Default trigger: icon-only "more" button; pass `trigger` (an element) to use your own. /

components.name: PageActionsProvider
components.summary: Page-level actions (Thêm máy in, Thêm automation…) live in the top-right corner of the page header.

components.name: PageActionsSlot
components.summary: Where the actions appear: the right end of the page header row. */

components.name: PageActions
components.summary: Renders its children in the page header slot (inline when the page has no slot). */

components.name: PageTitle
components.summary: Page title and underline display-tab heading of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §1, §4a).

components.name: PageTabsTitle
components.summary: Underline display tabs used when a view groups 2–4 sibling sub-pages (e.g. "Máy in / Job in", "Sản phẩm / Danh mục"). Replaces putting a separate <Pills> bar directly under a <PageTitle>. /

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page-number pager: ‹ 1 … 4 [5] 6 … 12 ›.

components.name: Pills
components.summary: Single-choice pill group (filters, period / chart toggles).

components.name: RefreshButton
components.summary: Icon-only "Làm mới" page action: reloads the page's data; the icon spins while the reload runs (a button running its own action may show a spinner, §13b).

components.name: SearchInput
components.summary: Collapsible search box: shows a search icon button by default; expands into the text field on click or when active (value is not empty).

components.name: SidePanelToggle
components.summary: The collapse toggle placed at the top of the panel content (next to the first label). */

components.name: SidePanel
components.summary: Left settings panel of the stand-alone tool apps: bg-panel, collapses to a thin rail with the same sidebar toggle as the home menu.

components.name: Skeleton

components.name: SkeletonCard

components.name: SkeletonGrid

components.name: SkeletonRows
components.summary: List row placeholders (dialog lists, tables). */

components.name: PageSkeleton
components.summary: Whole-page placeholder (Suspense fallbacks): title row + a grid of cards. */

components.name: Table

components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TH

components.name: Tabs

components.name: ToastHost

hooks.name: useField
hooks.summary: The surrounding Field's ids and state (null outside a Field). */

hooks.name: useCoarsePointer
hooks.summary: True on devices with a touch screen (phones, tablets). Re-evaluated on change. Not just `(pointer: coarse)`: an iPad with a Magic Keyboard / trackpad (typically landscape) reports a fine primary pointer, and iPadOS "desktop website" mode looks like a Mac; both still have a touch screen (`any-pointer: coarse`, `maxTouchPoints`). Macs report 0 touch points. */

hooks.name: useScrollLock
hooks.summary: Lock page scroll while `active` (nested dialogs share one lock). */

hooks.name: useFocusTrap
hooks.summary: Trap keyboard focus inside `ref` while `active`; Escape calls onEscape (captured so it closes only the top dialog). Focus goes to the element with [data-autofocus] or [autofocus], else the first focusable, else the container. /

hooks.name: useDialog
hooks.summary: Everything a modal-like surface needs: focus trap, scroll lock, Escape, and an id for aria-labelledby. */

hooks.name: useSemiLocale
hooks.summary: Strings for the current locale (vi unless a SemiLocaleProvider says otherwise). */

functions.name: chipClass
functions.summary: Colour classes of a filter chip (add CHIP_BASE + your own size). Same for every chip. */

functions.name: chipIconClass
functions.summary: Text colour of a chip's leading icon: the item's tone (kept when selected, the background is what changes). */

functions.name: pageWindow
functions.summary: Page numbers to show around `page` (1-based); `null` = an ellipsis. */

functions.name: themeScript
functions.summary: Inline script that sets data-theme + .dark/.light on <html> before the first paint (no flash of the wrong theme). Keep the options identical to ThemeProvider's. Exported as a string for non-React heads. /

functions.name: confirmDialog
functions.summary: Resolves true when the user picks the confirm button. A dialog opened while another shows cancels the first. */

functions.name: headerPrimary
functions.summary: The app's main action at the right of the header (Slice, Phối màu, Xong). */

functions.name: cn
functions.summary: Join class names, skipping falsy parts: cn(BTN_PRIMARY, busy && "opacity-60", className). Later classes are appended, not merged: to change a Semi surface pick another constant / prop instead of overriding it. */
